results.subtitle: Based on your budget, priorities and investment horizon.

items.title: JVC — anomalous yield
items.body: At an average $320K, net yield of 7.2% beats most European markets. The driver: expats relocating from over-priced districts. Ideal for cashflow investors with budgets up to $500K.

items.title: Creek Harbour — the next CBD
items.body: A tower taller than Burj Khalifa is rising here. A new business cluster. Growth of +10.5%/year at $690K is a record for the mid segment. Off-plan buyers from 2024–2026 will see the strongest ROI.

items.title: Business Bay — first-time buyer pick
items.body: Affordable entry ($540K) plus central location — steady corporate demand, 6%+ yield, 8%/year growth. The best risk/return balance for those entering the market for the first time.

districts.name: JVC
districts.desc: Affordable entry ticket. Highest net yield in Dubai at 7.2%. Active development, mass expat relocation from pricier districts.

districts.name: JLT
districts.desc: Business cluster next to the Marina. DMCC Free Zone delivers stable corporate rental demand.

districts.name: Business Bay
districts.desc: Central CBD with canal views. The best balance of price, yield and location — ideal for a first investment.

districts.name: Dubai Marina
districts.desc: Waterfront, tourists and expats. City-best 91% occupancy. Strong Airbnb potential.

districts.name: Creek Harbour
districts.desc: A tower taller than Burj Khalifa is rising here. A new CBD. Strong off-plan growth in the mid segment.

districts.name: MBR City
districts.desc: Dubai's largest master plan: EMAAR, Sobha, MAG. Maturing infrastructure, green district.

districts.name: Dubai Hills
districts.desc: EMAAR master plan with golf course and parks. Family segment with high tenant retention.

districts.name: Downtown
districts.desc: Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall. Maximum liquidity. A prestige rental address with strong corporate and tourist demand.

districts.name: Sobha Hartland
districts.desc: Highest capital appreciation at 11%/year. Waterfront premium development by Sobha. Best for hold-and-sell strategies.

districts.name: Palm Jumeirah
districts.desc: The iconic archipelago. Villas and apartments with sea views. Long-term capital growth and a status address.
